::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Apple's Bengaluru silicon team was seeded by the 2019 acquisition of Intel's smartphone modem business, which brought ~160 modem engineers. The team works on SoC platform architecture and wireless silicon development.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Wireless modem silicon, SoC platform architecture, and hardware verification for Apple's custom processors used in iPhone, iPad, and Mac products.
